name: Adobe Firefly — Content Tagging
description: Content Tagging service for Adobe Firefly: a ContentTaggingPort + adapter that returns structured tags/metadata for an image (the one service whose result is JSON, not an asset — exercises the foundation's non-asset path). Sync or short async; presigns the input only.
checklist: Confirm the Content Tagging entitlement + scope on your Adobe Developer Console project
Verify the current endpoint/payload against Adobe docs — the adapter handles both a sync response (tags inline) and a short async job, so it works either way; confirm the path
Provide a presigned input href (core passthrough) or install an adobe-firefly-storage-* addon — no output storage is needed (the result is JSON, not an asset)
Tune the confidence floor per environment via ADOBE_TAGGING_MIN_CONFIDENCE (install default set the baseline)
